TEXT: The 3-day, 2-night field trip ended safely.
I was struggling to walk on the way home with Manami.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, you look tired.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: While you look quite energetic instead.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Yes! I was thinking that I would've liked to stay another night.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, Kyoto is perfect for grannies. Since they're both old...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hm? Did you say something, Kyou-chan?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: No, it's nothing. Anyway, for today, go home and get some rest.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Okay, thank you. You too.
Looking at Manami's usual smile, it's somehow reassuring.
Rather, it feels like I'm back to my ordinary life.
Since up till now, it was probably that the school trip was out of the ordinary.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Kyou-chan, is something wrong?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Huh? Oh, I'm just thinking that seeing your vacant expression is kind of soothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: R-Really!? I'm glad～

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Nah, it's not really a compliment...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: But seeing me calms you down, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I guess so.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Then, that is a compliment～. Hehehe...
As always, this girl gets flustered from the weirdest things.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I don't particularly dislike that part of you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Or rather, don't pick up any new quirks and stay like that for me.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Hm? Stay like what?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Ah, it's nothing.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Really? Then, that's fine...
And she's as sincere as always.
A soothing atmosphere... I wonder if that's what I'm unconsciously looking for?
As we were walking while chatting, we reached the street where we usually part ways...

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: B-By the way! Kyou-chan!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Hm? What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Are you free tomorrow?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Tomorrow? I don't really have anything planned so yeah. Also, stop fidgeting, it's creepy.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: I-I'm not fidgeting! Geez, Kyou-chan (><)!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Sorry, sorry. So, what's up?

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: ...There's something I want to talk about.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Well, I don't mind. School... isn't a good idea, huh? Then... How about on the way back home tomorrow? Around the park.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: Y-Yes. Th-Then let's do that.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: Okay, got it.

SPEAKER: SPK_MANAMI
TEXT: S-See you tomorrow then, Kyou-chan.
...It can't be.
Don't tell me she also...
Nah, she would be the last person for that.
